regime_context: US market shows the absolute-trend gate as validated risk control and gate_helps=true, so trend discipline is meaningful here, but the rank-IC is ~0 (attention only) and the tracker's own directional accuracy is 44% over 108 calls — below coin-flip. The detector flags a narrowing rotation (47% of themes eligible) with no one-narrative dominance, no directional handoff, and absorption at 0.31. I will keep conviction low and theses strictly conditional.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: The absolute-trend gate is the one validated staying-power leg, and this theme shows the strongest durability_bar (0.84), trend hurst_tag, and best breadth (0.889) of any eligible name — a trend-following, vol-aware case for continuation rather than a return forecast. I lean toward the high-durability trend rather than the highest momentum rank, since the rank itself has no forward edge.
evidence: absolute_trend_gate validated as risk control / staying-power leg
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded (crowding_z 1.02, crowded true), which the guardrails warn is a size-down caution — crowded leadership is statistically prone to shake-outs even inside an intact trend.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks below its 50-day moving average with breadth below 0.6 before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: Trend-eligible with a strong durability_bar (0.72), trend hurst_tag, and the best breadth in the software bucket (0.786). Under the vol-aware trend-gate lens, this is a continuation lean. The crowding flag (1.14) is noted only as a reason to keep it small, not to fade it.
theses.dissent: The theme is crowded and the crowded label has no basket-level forward edge — it could be late in the trend and vulnerable to a sharp drawdown even if the long-run direction persists.

falsifier.text: IGV lags SPY by 5% over any rolling two-week window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Insurance & Brokers
theses.thesis: Trend-eligible with high durability (0.67) and the strongest breadth outside healthcare (0.789), not crowded (z 0.61). This is a clean trend-gate continuation case with coherent participation and no crowding caution.
theses.dissent: Score is near zero (0.078) and the theme is rank 26 — it has no momentum attention at all, so this is purely a slow, defensive trend lean that may drift rather than outperform.

falsifier.text: KIE breaks below its 200-day moving average before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
